description: Keccak-256 hash (the Ethereum hash) of text or of 0x hex bytes, as used for function selectors, event topics and storage slots. Use when building or decoding EVM calls. Example: text=transfer(address,uint256). Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

text.description: Text, or 0x-prefixed hex bytes, up to 10,000 characters

name: keccak
title: Keccak-256 hash
